headline: Apple to unveil new smart home lineup, including LG-made devices, at October 13 event
summary: Apple is reportedly partnering with LG on a new line of smart home devices, including a lock, doorbell, thermostat, camera and temperature sensor, images of which have surfaced online. Apple has officially announced an October 13 event in New York under the tagline 'Welcome home,' widely expected to introduce a new smart home hub, refreshed Apple TV and HomePod Mini, and possibly a new homeOS platform, alongside the LG-made accessories.
